policy: NOT_READY if any readiness blocker fails, data integrity fails, a trace does not reproduce the scorecard, or a money invariant is broken.
NEEDS_REVIEW if an open investigation workspace at the branch supports or leaves open misclassification (H3) or missing data (H4), or integrity passes only with warnings.
READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS if the decision rests on attribution without a measured effect, on figures that leave held records out, or on an unknown-channel share above 20%.
READY otherwise: every rule passed, including a completed randomized holdout for the channel.

aa.label: A/A analysis self-check (statistics only)
aa.limitation: Arms are computed at analysis time from a hash of each lead id; no assignment is logged at lead time and no treatment or exposure exists. This checks the unit definition, outcome join and statistics only: it cannot detect assignment or exposure-logging faults.

config.unit: A prospect's first web lead in the period (one unit per person)
config.assignment: Arm A if sha256("aa-web-v1:web:<source lead id>") as uint32 / 2³² < 0.5, else B; computed at analysis time over the analysed leads (never logged at lead time)
config.outcome: Converted = the lead's prospect (same phone or email hash) became a new customer: first subscription sold within [lead − 2 h, lead + 14 days] with its initial service completed by lead + 14 days.
config.guardrail: Refund rate among converted units (successful refund recorded by the as-of date)

conclusion.text: Too few mature units to compare (17 vs 23; at least 30 per arm). No conclusion.
